# The slim base (P9): the Unix tool ports that are upkg packages instead of part of up-term.lha.
# One line per path a package owns: <package id> <path in the ports' userland tree>. A path may
# use * (a file name pattern). This is the one list: tools/slim.py reads it to take the paths out of
# the base kit (make dist-base), to stage them into the package (make dist-<id>) and to write the
# package's Uninstall lines. The package installs them at the same paths in UP-Term: the base used.
# Columns are separated by two or more spaces. The ports' SOURCES.txt row of <package id> moves with it.
git   bin/git
git   bin/git-*
git   share/git-core
git   licenses/git
perl  bin/perl
perl  licenses/perl
vim   bin/vim
vim   share/vim
vim   share/man/man1/vim.1
vim   licenses/vim
bitchx  bin/BitchX
bitchx  lib/bx
bitchx  share/man/man1/BitchX.1.bz2
bitchx  licenses/bitchx
